name: Sanguis Amantis
source:
Many moons ago, The Lady of All Sin collided with the Earth, bringing about an age of terror and destruction. Her acolytes, the Vestal Maidens, are beacons of purity-- ridding the wasteland of anyone who does not fall in line with their beliefs. 

In the cathedral of Sin, one maiden is frustrated by her loneliness, and seeks to create a companion for herself using forbidden rituals. Upon succeeding, there is only one question to be asked.

Will her creation love her back?

[From [url=https://dt75art.itch.io/sanguis-amantis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
许多个月前，万罪女士与地球相撞，带来了一个恐怖和毁灭的时代。她的追随者维斯塔少女是纯洁的灯塔——清除荒原上任何不符合其信仰的人。

在罪恶大教堂中，一位少女因孤独而感到沮丧，并试图通过禁忌仪式为自己创造一个伴侣。成功后，只需问一个问题。

她的创造物会爱她吗？

[来自[url=https://dt75art.itch.io/sanguis-amantis]itch.io[/url]]
